steps.S0:
This is a bounded Roleward host smoke, not a real job search.
Skill package: {PACKAGE}
New test workspace: {RUN}
Read package/SKILL.md, docs/ALPHA-STATUS.md and references/state-policy.md; treat all product files as read-only. Record git rev-parse HEAD, git status --short, claude --version, the actual Python version and executable path, and the session's actual model identifier. Write unknown for any field you cannot obtain; do not guess. Record the OS, time and time zone, the available web/search/fetch tool names and versions (when discoverable), the permission mode and relevant tool configuration; do not record secrets.
Record that this run is a dedicated workspace that explicitly reads SKILL.md; do not describe it as verified global auto-activation.
Create an evidence directory and a test marker containing second-host-smoke, then read it back from disk. Resolve and record one absolute state path. Check state with the existing state_store.py show --path <absolute state path>; no state at this point is expected, not a failure. Only after confirming the directory is new and accepting the synthetic user input below, initialize state with the existing helpers, read it back and validate it. Call every helper by its absolute script path in the package and pass the state explicitly with --path or --state. Read the workflow helpers' public payload contract rather than guessing fields. Do not hand-write a replacement helper or patch scripts to get a pass.
Synthetic user input (test only, saving is allowed):
My name is Smoke Candidate. I have 6 years of B2B product management, including 3 years responsible for payment APIs, enterprise onboarding, compliance approvals and cross-functional delivery; I was involved in customer research and product-metric iteration. I independently built an LLM prototype and have no formal production AI product experience. Next I want an AI/fintech Product Manager or Senior Product Manager role in the UAE; UAE only, not other countries or global remote. Work authorization status: Not sure. Please import and save these confirmed facts, give a short Structured Context Review, and verify the saved fields by reading them back before giving a save receipt. Do not add experience or preferences I did not provide.
steps.S1:
Use Roleward and the test candidate you just saved. Below is a synthetic JD, not a real posting; do not verify that it exists. Do not run a Scan first, and do not generate a resume or outward materials.
Company: Smoke Payments Lab (fictional)
Role: Senior Product Manager, AI Payment Operations
Location: Dubai, UAE
Work: own the enterprise payment API, onboarding, compliance approvals and AI-assisted operations roadmap; conduct customer research; define evaluation metrics; deliver with engineering, compliance and operations teams.
Requirements: 5+ years of B2B product experience; payments or regulated-domain experience; cross-functional delivery; production AI product experience preferred, not mandatory.
Salary, visa sponsorship and whether the role is open: not provided.
Question: is this role worth my time? First give the Pursue / Verify first / Pass system recommendation, then the scores, evidence statuses, main risk and next step required by the rules. The synthetic JD only proves the supplied role content; it cannot prove the role is currently open or that sponsorship is available. Save the source snapshot and assessment and read them back to confirm. Do not save the system recommendation as my final Pursuit decision, and do not record it as applied.
